_description: Monetization switches read by build.py. Leave a value empty to keep that feature off.
adsense_note: Set to your AdSense publisher id (ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) after approval. build.py then injects the AdSense script on every page (Auto ads) and writes ads.txt.
ads_txt_note: Paste the ads.txt line AdSense gives you, e.g. google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
affiliate_disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through them, 404 Memory Found may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. We only link to things we would look for ourselves.
ebay_note: eBay Partner Network campaign id. When set, build.py appends the tracking parameters to every ebay.com link in post bodies and marks it rel="sponsored nofollow".
amazon_note: Amazon Associates tracking id (e.g. 404memoryfound-20). When set, build.py appends ?tag= to amazon.com links and marks them rel="sponsored nofollow".
